notes.title: v1.0.2-2025.21.4.2 - Store Expansion & Outdoor Furniture Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Mini Racer Enthusiasts 🛠️🏪

We’re back with another [b]content and feature update[/b], bringing more ways to expand, decorate, and manage your dream store!

Thank you once again for all the feedback and reports. We’ve used it to continue shaping the game with improvements both big and small.

[h1][b]New Features & Improvements[/b][/h1]

[b]• Store Expansion[/b]  
You can now expand your store’s interior space! After saving up enough in-game money, you can unlock store area, giving you [b]more area to arrange shelves and furniture[/b] however you like. To access this upgrade you can interact with new door you find in the left side of the store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/9f31d859e9ad30c09b4a1c7e5119598aec6c7720.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/c25a75169d2d06af569b87e5b85cc51109e357ff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/f015ae4661478a4c8b6e27b1b17a4691eab856fe.png[/img]
[b]• Wallpaper Expansion Area[/b]  
With the new store size comes [b]additional wall sections[/b] for decoration. You can now apply wallpapers to these expanded areas after purchasing the store expansion. In the Wallpaper Menu in the Tablet now you can select what wallpaper you want to put in the first area and the second one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/4263077204b04bcd0f65754aafddd08237c08924.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/00d2145b934060a97f3197a9bf6ef39bc900b9d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/c48a2ebb06e5f4dec01e098622aea379ce2240ef.png[/img]
[b]• Place Furniture Outside[/b]  
You can now [b]place furniture outside your store[/b]! Not only that, the outdoor area also expands along with your shop, so you’ll have [b]more space for creative layouts both indoors and outdoors[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/944120454b7de9c275b1406d478ca1983e690af9.png[/img]
[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]

[b]• Yellow Pickup Marker Bug on Furniture[/b]  
We’ve fixed a bug where the [b]yellow placement marker would not disappear[/b] after moving shelves. This should now behave correctly when adjusting furniture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/55459ee2ee57b2f9d9dc5b8da6ce5011e9060383.png[/img]
[b]• Localization Reset Fix[/b]  
Fixed a minor issue where [b]the localization system broken when returning to the main menu[/b]. Language settings should now remain consistent throughout.

---

We hope you enjoy these new options to expand and personalize your shop even more. As always, [b]thank you for playing and supporting the game[/b].

If you're enjoying your time with Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator, we’d love it if you could leave a [b]positive review on our Steam page[/b]. Every review helps us grow!

See you in the next update and lets expand your store!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294630/Mini_Racer_Car_Shop_Simulator/

notes.title: v1.0.1-2025.20.2.3 - Better Box Handling, Quality of Life Update & Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone 🚗🏁

First of all, we want to say a huge [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who has played [b]Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator[/b], left feedback, and joined the discussions on Steam. Your support and suggestions have been incredibly helpful in shaping this first update after launch.

We’ve been listening closely to your experiences, and today we’re rolling out several improvements and fixes based on your reports.

[h1][b]New Features & Improvements[/b][/h1]

[b]• Improved Box Handling System[/b]  
We’ve updated the box carrying experience. The view now feels more comfortable when looking down, and the wobble effect has been removed, making box handling smoother and less distracting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/d1e025b0d0982dd065f0b45d776cf67e5661ef28.png[/img]
[b]• Take Back Items from Shelves[/b]  
Made a placement mistake? You can now [b]take back packs from shelves[/b] directly to the empty box in your hand, making store management and reorganization more flexible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/f373095467588b54ccf5077182144f6b4280b879.png[/img]
[b]• Faster Opening Spare Part Box[/b]  
Spare parts box now open [b]instantly[/b] without the extra unboxing animation, saving you time when need to open up spare part to customize your car.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/8d0b87440ffaa5c61499a09db80b4515924daf4a.png[/img]
[b]• Immersive Mode (HUD Toggle)[/b]  
You can now toggle [b]Immersive Mode[/b] to hide all HUD elements, giving you a clean and distraction-free view. Perfect for focusing on the environment or capturing beautiful screenshots. Simply press the dedicated key to turn the HUD on or off at any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/d7df0830b04ee931bfbd61e9dc15c9cb762a4062.png[/img]
[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]

[b]• Fixed Customers Getting Stuck at Race Track[/b]  
We’ve fixed an issue where customers could get stuck at the race track until night, preventing store closure. This should now work as intended with smoother customer behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/fb8a3b71a9c14ebf1b986a7e50298b447c39f631.png[/img]
---

As always, thank you for your continued feedback and support. If you have feedback you can tell us more through the discussion and [b]if you found any issue you can send through in-game Bug Report and tell us the problems[/b]. The in-game Bug Report Menu located in the Tab Menu on the Docs & Feedback.

If you’re enjoying the game, we’d really appreciate it if you could leave a positive review on our store page. Your support helps us improve and grow Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator for everyone.

See you in the next update and happy racing! 🏆🚗  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294630/Mini_Racer_Car_Shop_Simulator/

notes.title: Optimization Update for Better and Smoother Play
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
In this devlog, we’re stepping away for a moment from gameplay content to talk about something just as important: performance optimization.

Thanks to all the feedback we received from players who tried the demo and prologue, we’ve been working hard to make the game run smoother, load faster, and feel better overall. These changes may not always be visible, but they make a real difference in how stable and comfortable the game feels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/111a7f2bcbc952a9ab517ee0ff1ea293ec618f58.png[/img]
[h2]What’s Been Optimized?[/h2]
Here are some of the key areas we’ve focused on:
[list]
[*] [b]Improved data loading[/b] – Game data is now loaded more efficiently, helping reduce wait times and lower memory usage, especially when transitioning between scenes.
[*] [b]Better data handling[/b] – We’ve optimized how background systems process data, minimizing small stutters and improving flow during gameplay.
[*] [b]UI performance improvements[/b] – Complex UI elements have been optimized so they no longer interfere with core systems, even when multiple menus are active.
[*] [b]Algorithm refinements[/b] – Several internal processes have been reworked to use less processing power, making gameplay smoother and more responsive.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/994d541c6d770699e63ae19ba3d84ea612663ea2.png[/img]
The game also includes a Settings menu that lets players adjust the game’s performance based on their hardware. These options have been available since the beginning, and include:
[list]
[*] [b]Quality settings[/b] – Adjust overall visual quality
[*] [b]Max FPS[/b] – Set the frame rate cap to suit your device
[*] [b]Anti-aliasing[/b] – Toggle smoothing options for sharper visuals
[*] [b]VSync[/b] – Sync frame rate with monitor refresh rate to reduce screen tearing
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/e3057cc817687286bc51adfb3d73a25cfce0e67a.png[/img]
These settings are useful whether you’re playing on a high-end setup or something more modest. Our goal is to make sure the game feels good to play across as many systems as possible.

All these improvements are designed to support a smoother and more reliable experience, from customizing your cars to managing your shop to racing on track. We want every part of the game to run efficiently so you can focus on playing, not waiting or tweaking constantly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/59e47462cf6b1c05ef96589d6cfa47564d82904d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/5d286c8b27e17a175cbc723c664cb543d238b907.png[/img]
You can already feel some of these improvements in the latest Prologue version, and we’ll continue optimizing other parts of the game ahead of the full release.

Thanks for reading. We’ve got more devlogs lined up, focusing on other features and content you’ll see in the full game.

Wishlist Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator on Steam today and be the first to know when the full game ready! Thanks for following along! Happy Racings 🏁

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294630/Mini_Racer_Car_Shop_Simulator/

notes.title: Update v2024.51.1.1 - Spare Part Installation Flexibility and More
notes.notes:
Hi Mini Racer Car Lovers!! 🏎️🚗

Welcome to our first devlog! Based on our Steam dashboard report, there are now hundreds of players who have tried the game. We’ve also seen some YouTubers play the demo. Thank you for all your enthusiasm for Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator! 😀

Through the gameplay you've been doing, we've identified some improvements that need to be made. These improvements cover feature additions, feature enhancements, and bug fixes. Here are the first improvements we've made:

+ Ability to uninstall non-primary spare parts (Booster, AI Chip, Suspension)
+ Players are made invisible while racing (so the player's feet aren’t blocking the car)
+ Fixed the car placed in the bottom-left pitstop that couldn't be retrieved
+ Fixed customers getting stuck at the racing arena door when loading the game
+ Fixed the customer's body disappearing while waiting for payment during game load
+ Separated the Feedback menu into Feedback (Steam Hub) and Feedback (Form)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/4d064bbbe42c524e75dfc778bc458e1678d2b817.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343939/7339b9801d7a19752e45ebc8b9309d0f6d585cdf.jpg[/img]

We are always open to all feedback and suggestions to make this game as mature as possible. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts.

Thank you for being part of the community, and happy racing! 🏎️🚗
